briefing: Markets were flat today with NASDAQ +0.1% and S&P 500 -0.1%, showing no clear directional conviction. Per prior lessons learned, we only deploy fresh capital into new positions on genuine risk-on days (NASDAQ +2% or more), so we're holding cash and letting existing positions ride rather than forcing a buy.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Risk-Off describes a cautious market stance where investors avoid adding new exposure until conditions show clearer bullish confirmation. Today's neutral market (NASDAQ +0.1%) didn't meet the bar for deploying new capital, so holding cash and existing positions was the disciplined choice rather than forcing trades.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「Risk-Off」（避險模式）指投資者在市場方向未明朗前，傾向審慎行事、避免增加新持倉。今日大市走勢中性（納指僅升0.1%），未達到部署新資金的門檻，因此持有現金及現有持倉、不勉強進行交易，才是較為紀律嚴謹的做法。

market_education.summary_en: Today's trading was essentially directionless, with the NASDAQ edging up 0.1% while the S&P 500 dipped 0.1%, reflecting a market in a holding pattern rather than reacting to any major catalyst. Without a strong risk-on or risk-off signal, institutional participation appears muted, which is consistent with sideways, low-volume price action. In the absence of a clear trend, it's prudent to preserve capital rather than chase momentum that isn't confirmed by broader market strength.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢波瀾不驚，納指微升0.1%，標普500則微跌0.1%，反映市場處於觀望狀態，未有明顯催化劑帶動方向。在缺乏強烈的風險偏好或避險訊號下，機構參與度似乎較為淡靜，與窄幅波動、成交量偏低的走勢吻合。在趨勢未明朗之前，保留現金比追逐未經大市確認的動力更為穩健。
